reasons: Both answers admit the earlier advice was wrong, limit retries to transient errors, return the error to the model with a way to see the schema, and add a loop guard while keeping recursion_limit as a backstop. B adds a useful diagnostic step: check what the ToolMessage actually contains, because without reraise tenacity can hide the original error inside a RetryError. B also puts the schema straight into the error message and uses a guard keyed on identical calls, which matches the trace more closely. A's error-budget guard and explicit describe_table tool are solid but slightly less targeted.
